|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/atstdualcannon.html</ref>

Simply a repeating firing, +1 weapon for your AT-ST's. The real bonus is that your AT-ST's are reasonably immune to most weapon fire, thus your weapon is likely to stay on table for longer than a character weapon (which just begs to be targeted).

Combos: How to get and keep your cannon on table! * [[Heavy Fire Zone]] will get the Dual Cannon deployed from reserve for free. * [[Vizam]] will also allow it to deploy free at same site, and can take it form Reserve Deck if with an [[Advosze]]. * [[Firepower]] will recover them from the Lost Pile.
|combos=* [[AT-ST Dual Cannon]] + [[Tempest Scout 4]] [[AT-ST Dual Cannon]] deploys free aboard and may target at an adjacent site.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=AT-ST%20Dual%20Cannon</ref>
|pulled_by=* [[Vizam]] (when with [[Advosze]])
